tools.name: agentobserver_interfaces
tools.description: Discover all public AgentObserver interfaces: HTTP/x402, MCP/x402 and A2A.

tools.name: agentobserver_targets
tools.description: Start here: list registered counterparties, ready-to-call free status actions, paid eligibility and exact purchase routes. Use a target relevant to your workflow.

tools.name: agentobserver_dependencies
tools.description: List demand-backed external dependencies observed in public agent markets. Evidence is dated and factual; inclusion is not an endorsement.

tools.name: agentobserver_resolve
tools.description: Resolve providers for a capability using factual filters and dated demand evidence. Sorting is not a trust score.

tools.name: agentobserver_spend_status
tools.description: Inspect one catalog resource before spending. Optionally performs only an operator-approved unsigned GET/HEAD probe; never sends credentials or payment signatures.

tools.name: agentobserver_status
tools.description: Free preflight status: show freshness, reachability, material changes and factual reasons that deserve review before relying on or paying a registered counterparty.

tools.name: agentobserver_dependency_preflight
tools.description: Paid x402 dependency Preflight: return a fresh hash-bound pre-spend report for an eligible real catalog resource.

tools.name: agentobserver_preflight
tools.description: Paid x402 Preflight: return fresh machine-readable evidence about a registered AI-agent counterparty.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "agentobserver_spend_status" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
